confidence_notes: Two web searches were used: one for the RBA rate and one for Saranda prices. The FX figure is the RBA 4pm reading for 18 Nov 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD), as reported by search result summaries; the rba.gov.au page itself was not opened. Food and drink anchors come from aggregated crowdsourced and modelled cost-of-living sites (Expat Exchange, Nomad Ranker, Where and When, mylifeelsewhere). Their data dates from 2023 to March 2026 and the sources disagree: beer is about $1-4, cappuccino about $1-3, inexpensive meal about $8-11 and mid-range meal for two about $15-30. The anchors are set above the middle of these ranges to reflect July peak season and seafront tourist pricing. Cocktail and wine were not searched directly; they are estimated from their usual price relationship to beer in Albania and are less certain. All accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge for peak summer in a popular Albanian Riviera resort town, not from booking data, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Albanian Riviera and southern Balkan coastal resorts such as Vlore, Durres and Ksamil, with a July high-season premium over Albania-wide averages.
